tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check domain availability using DNS, then authoritative registry RDAP, then WHOIS as needed. Returns status, source, explanation, and check time. Available means the registry reports availability or no registration record; registrar reservations and pricing are not checked. Unknown means verification was inconclusive, never available.

name.description: domain name to check, without the TLD

tld.description: top-level domain, such as com, org, or net

tools.name: list_tlds
tools.description: Get a list of all available top-level domains (TLDs)
